_comment: SCA (src/ + xpi/) whose committed lock records tinylib at 1.2.2 while its resolved URL fetches the 1.2.1 tarball: the audit would ask about a release npm ci never installs. lockfile-injection reports the entry at its line and stops the review, so the lock is never audited: no OSV request, no CDN lookup, no parse. The URL is on the registry's tarball path, so the comparison is offline. It runs second, right after the Experiment verdict, so no other check has reported anything when it stops the review. The shipped background.js is minified, so the archive does not hold the XPI.
